propositions: The per-event oracle in the batched-map equivalence test returns None on transient Git errors (rc128, rc0/empty, BlockingIOError) while the batched resolver recovers, causing false equivalence assertion failures.
Production resolve_event_commit deliberately maps all Git errors and empty results to None, preserving fail-closed semantics for live authorship verification and must not be changed.

The test fixture was fixed by adding a bounded retry helper (_fixture_per_event_commit) that retries the per-event oracle up to five times and returns only non-None SHA values, matching the batched resolver's recovery strategy.
All batched/per-event exact SHA equivalence assertions in the test module now route through the bounded oracle helper, including off-first-parent and ledger-parity cases.
